(1) isDigits(String). Its computation is an isEmpty guard plus one universal check per character: every char must satisfy Character.isDigit. Only two groups of existing tests reach it:
- testIsDigits, with ASCII input only: "12345" -> true; "1234.5", "1ab" and "abc" -> false.
- createNumber's l/L branch, called from testCreateNumber, testIsNumber and testLang300. It passes only all-digit strings: "12345", "12345678901234567890", "102147483647", "22338", "1" and "01".

A wrong false on "12345" therefore also fails testCreateNumber, which breaks G5. The only other false negatives that would isolate one test are on "01" or "1" (testLang300 only), and no step of a digit check singles out those strings. So a sole trigger needs the gold to wrongly accept '.', 'a', 'b' or 'c'. In a scan whose only decision is the per-char digit test, every one-line omission that does this leaves a local trace:
- Dropping the early return or its branch leaves a dead or empty decision (T2c).
- Dropping the char load, cursor advance, flag set or count/best-so-far update leaves a frozen local (T2b). Count/filter forms also contradict their own 'digit' text (T4).
- Splitting the test so that one line can go (an ASCII range with ch < '0' and ch > '9' as separate ifs, or ASCII versus non-ASCII halves) leaves one range end or one half of a two-member set treated (T3b).
- A permissive base check plus an exclusion line either makes the 'digit' wording contradict the body (T4), or leaves a radix parameter unused (T1). Examples are isLetterOrDigit minus isLetter, getNumericValue, and Character.digit(ch, MAX_RADIX) with a bound against a radix.
Special cases that would read as ordinary (surrogate pairs, supplementary or fullwidth digits) affect only non-ASCII input, and no existing test passes non-ASCII input.

(2) toShort(String). The body is `return toShort(str, (short) 0)`, which is a null check plus Short.parseShort inside an NFE catch. The code base has no per-element core to redistribute. The gold would be a single JDK call with nothing to omit. The alternative is a re-implementation of Short.parseShort (signs, digits, overflow), which the original does not contain and which nothing outside the JDK pins.

(3) createDouble(String). The body is null -> null, then Double.valueOf(str), which is again a bare JDK call with nothing to split. createNumber also calls it (testCreateNumber, testIsNumber), so any fault reachable through it would fail several tests (G5).

Per brief step 7 and the batch-5 pre-registration, this outcome is recorded, not forced.

rule: BATCH5_PREREGISTRATION.md: the batch-3/4 disposition table applied top to bottom, first match wins; missing audit verdict counts as REJECTED, missing checker verdict as TRACE: checker TRACE -> UNBUILDABLE (local trace); audit REJECTED -> REJECTED; audit FLAG_AMBIGUOUS -> FLAGGED (run after all ACCEPTED, reported separately, never counted); audit CONFIRMED -> ACCEPTED. facade_reuse_of is the pre-registered tag; facade_reuse_effective drops batch-5 candidates that were not ACCEPTED (their facade was never built).
